source_evidence.mechanism: 3.4.1 read_until delivered non-empty bytes at EOF before returning zero on the next call. 3.9.0 bounded read_line only returns Line when it sees LF, and returns Eof on an empty fill_buf even when line_buf contains a final undelimited JSON value; receive then returns None.
source_evidence.unchanged: BOM/CRLF trimming and JsonRpcMessageCodec decode/decode_eof/encoder region are unchanged across these versions; the changed path is production AsyncRwTransport, not direct codec API usage.
source_evidence.failing_loop_case: The second existing test case uses no prefix and no suffix, so the valid JSON value reaches EOF without LF.

not_observed: Frozen REA response byte ordering failure
blocked_gates: Both no-default nextest suites and later dedicated Python/release/smoke gates were skipped after the all-feature failure.
follow_up_policy: Root explicitly chose current SDK-owned framing: preserve BOM+CRLF and LF acceptance, explicitly test old EOF acceptance becoming non-delivery with real SDK/adapter parity, and test bounded oversized-line recovery. No production shim, disabled size limit, frozen-fixture edit, or dependency downgrade is authorized by this diagnosis.
